channel.title: CIS 598 - Computer Science Project :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description Directed studies: selection, investigation and report on some topic not covered in prior courses; may include an implementation and/or experimentation component; may be done in collaboration with other students. Completion of a plan, two reviews, and a final report with literature review and project evaluation. Credit Hours 3 credits Course Overview Not yet drafted — pending course-designer’s detailed pass. resources/reference/degree-maps/cs.md lists this as one of three choices (with CIS 643, DEN 591) for the Year 4 Capstone. This is distinct in purpose from CIS 400’s capstone-of-the-core: the Year 4 Capstone validates the whole degree plus specialization work, where CIS 400 validates the two-year core alone.
